name.value: Sportsman's Inn On The Harbour Front

description.value: Sportsman's Inn On The Harbour Front is Port McNeill's only harbour-front hotel, with every room overlooking the Port McNeill Harbour. The property lists three affiliated restaurants as a guest amenity, and all rooms include a fridge, microwave, coffee maker, and work desk. It sits at the waterfront end of Beach Drive, making it a straightforward destination for cyclists arriving via the Island Highway corridor.
